summary: Date-relative source ekicube defaults, control-character stripping for --plain/--csv/--quiet, and actionable hints on source errors.
reason: (1) The source ekicube Example and pp:happy-args pinned --from-at/--end-at 2026-10-09, so examples and live dogfood would query a past day as time passes; the CLI now defaults from_at to today in JST and end_at to from_at (the API still requires both, so the MCP tool keeps them required). (2) --plain, --csv and --quiet printed decoded remote strings without the control-character stripping the human tables use; the shared output path now wraps the writer with safeTextWriter. (3) Domain-command source failures (timeout, network, 5xx, 403/429, 404) printed only the raw error; classifyLockerErr now adds a hint line. The generator should emit (2) in printOutputWithFlagsMetaAndKeep and should avoid fixed dates in happy_args.
call_sites:
if flags.quiet || flags.csv || flags.plain {
		w = newSafeTextWriter(w)
